title: monardella × subglabra
intro: Monardella × subglabra, commonly known as Purple Monardella or Purple Mountain Monardella, is a hybrid plant species of the genus Monardella. It is a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to the southwestern United States, particularly in the mountainous regions of California and Arizona. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Monardella × subglabra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
